Video to Data: Robot Dexterity Task Library and Dataset
	


	
		
	
	
		Dataset Description
	

This dataset contains samples of human demonstrations on manipulation tasks retargeted to bimanual Sharpa robot hands and episodes of robot executions that mimic the original human demonstrations.
